findings.F1: The edge effect is continuation, and it shows only in calm markets. In calm coins, a 5-day grid case closing in the top fifth of its 20-day range beats the coin's mean 5-day return by +4.40 % (t 4.40, 177 cases), and one in the bottom fifth trails it by -2.41 % (t -3.14, 163 cases). In agitated coins the same buckets give +1.78 % (t 1.16) and +0.28 % (t 0.18). (Ordinary t; these are folds B and C only.)
findings.F2: Calm edge continuation works on both sides and in every year. In calm, short side at the edge: +2.93 % (t 4.39, 213 cases); long side: +3.60 % (t 4.37, 229 cases). By year, 2018 to 2021: +2.84 %, +3.02 %, +4.04 %, +3.29 %, with day-pooled t of 1.65, 2.05, 2.46 and 2.02. By coin it is positive on all 10 coins (t from 0.58 to 2.83). The step-5 test was held back by its |forecast| weighting (t 1.71) more than by the effect.
findings.F3: In a calm coin at the top of its range, a strong up day adds to the move. Top of range after a day rising more than one 30-day daily swing: +7.02 % over 5 days (t_day 2.75, 66 cases on 26 days). Top of range after a flat day: +2.71 % (t_day 2.47, 141 cases on 61 days). At the bottom, a down day adds nothing: -2.94 % after a down day against -3.18 % after a flat day.
findings.F4: In calm coins, a single large up day is followed by further rise. After a day above 2 swings: +7.20 % over 5 days (t 2.39, 32 cases). After 1 to 2 swings: +2.97 % (t 2.14, 72 cases). Large down days are not followed by a reliable fall: -2.57 % (t -1.20) and -1.38 % (t -1.44). In agitated coins the same up days give -1.35 % and +6.22 % (t -0.53 and 0.93).

findings.F6: The book earns mostly on its long side. Long bar gains sum to 11.82 against 2.36 for shorts. Long trades average +5.43 % net (1244 trades), short trades -0.26 % (1462 trades).
findings.F7: Nothing stands out in agitated markets. A 5-day reversal there has signed means of +1.36 %, +1.96 %, -1.00 % and +0.47 % by year (t 0.42, 1.80, -0.29, 0.17). A weekday pattern (Wednesday -0.44 %, t -2.60; Friday +0.37 %, t 2.85) is one of many angles looked at and overlaps the held 045-01 "late week gain".

ideas.idea: In a calm market, a coin closing near the top of its 20-day high-low range after a day that rose more than its usual daily swing rises over the next 5 days. The larger that day's rise against the coin's 30-day swing, and the nearer the close to the top, the larger the rise.
ideas.consequence: In a calm coin, a trader should buy a close at the top of its 20-day range most heavily when the day itself was an unusually large rise.
ideas.name: calm range top surge continuation

ideas.idea: In a calm market, the larger a coin's one-day rise against the standard deviation of its daily returns over the past 30 days, the larger its rise over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: In a calm coin, a trader should treat an unusually large up day as a reason to buy for the next week, not to sell.
ideas.name: calm one-day surge continuation
